input.command:
python -c "
import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4');fs=[]
while True:
    r,f=c.read()
    if not r:break
    fs.append(f)
fs=np.array(fs);bg=np.median(fs,axis=0).astype(np.float32)
for i in range(40,85):
    f=fs[i].astype(np.float32)
    d=np.abs(f-bg).max(axis=2)
    d=d-np.median(d)
    m=(d>40).astype(np.uint8)
    m=cv2.morphologyEx(m,cv2.MORPH_OPEN,np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
    n,l,st,cen=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m)
    if n>1:
        k=1+np.argmax(st[1:,4]);x,y,w,h,a=st[k]
        ys,xs=np.nonzero(l==k)
        print(i,a,x,y,w,h,'bottom',y+h, 'minx_at_bottom', xs[ys>y+h-5].min(), xs[ys>y+h-5].max())
    if 45<=i<=75: cv2.imwrite(f'/tmp/frames/m{i}.jpg',np.hstack([fs[i],cv2.cvtColor(m*255,cv2.COLOR_GRAY2BGR)]))
"
